en.headline: MTR adjusts Tsuen Wan Line frequency for weekend signalling works
en.dek: Trains on the Tsuen Wan Line will run at longer intervals this weekend while the MTR carries out planned signalling upgrades between two stations.
body: The MTR Corporation said Tsuen Wan Line trains would run at longer intervals over the weekend as engineers carry out planned signalling upgrade works on a section of the line.
According to the operator, the adjustment affects services during off-peak hours, and additional staff will be deployed at busier interchange stations to help manage passenger flow.
Passengers were advised to allow extra travelling time and to check station notices for the latest service information. Normal frequencies are expected to resume once the works are completed.

zh.headline: 荃灣綫周末訊號系統工程 列車班次延長
zh.dek: 港鐵荃灣綫本周末進行預定訊號系統提升工程，兩站之間列車班次會延長，乘客需預留額外時間。
body: 港鐵公司表示，因應荃灣綫一段路段進行預定訊號系統提升工程，周末列車班次將會延長。
港鐵指，是次調整主要影響非繁忙時間服務，並會在較繁忙的轉車站加派人手，協助疏導乘客。
港鐵呼籲乘客預留額外乘車時間，並留意車站告示的最新服務資訊。工程完成後，列車班次將回復正常。
